richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Dhule

c: At about 260 km from our Vasai factory, Dhule is one of the closer towns we supply in north Maharashtra. FunPlay Systems makes Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment for housing societies, schools, colleges and municipal gardens across Dhule and the wider Khandesh region. Being in the same state keeps the road trip short, and our installation team can reach your site without a long wait for a regional dealer. It also means after-sales visits are easier to arrange if a part needs attention.

Khandesh has hot, dry summers and a single rainy season, so the machines spend most of the year in strong sun. Our frames are galvanised pipe and the seats are roto-moulded plastic, both chosen to stand outdoors all year. Tell us how many people use your garden each morning and how much space you have. We will suggest a set of machines and send a layout drawing showing the clear area around each one.

items.q: How is outdoor gym equipment installed on black cotton soil?
items.a: We usually recommend grouting, with the base set in concrete below the soft top layer. Black cotton soil moves between the wet and dry seasons, and a grouted base keeps the machine level.

items.q: Who installs the equipment in Dhule?
items.a: Our own installation team from Vasai or a local dealer. The machines travel by road from the factory, and the team fixes them as per the approved layout drawing.

items.q: Which machines suit a college campus?
items.a: Students usually prefer strength machines such as chest press, leg press and pull up stations. Add a twister or walker for staff and visitors who want lighter exercise.
